name: Hagoromo Foods Corporation
summary: Hagoromo Foods Corporation manufactures and sells various food products in Japan. The company offers household product, such as tuna, cooking ingredients, premix, pasta sauce, fruikake, seaweed, supplement, prepared foods, dessert, pasta, quick and easy rice, instant seasoning, and dried bonito flakes; commercial products, including vegetables, fruit, other dried goods, and broths; caned tuna gift, dessert gift, variety gift pasta gift, Japanese style variety gift and novelty gift; as well as pet food. The company was founded in 1931 and is headquartered in Shizuoka, Japan.
